typography.notes: Use condensed, technical sans-serif for headings (like dashboard gauges) and highly legible sans-serif for body (crucial for older audience). Never use Inter for headings.

colors.notes: Do not introduce colors outside this palette except for standard status colors. No gradients for backgrounds, keep it solid and flat with glowing accent borders. Accent #FF5722 is ONLY for intro anim, active filters, map pins, CTAs, featured badge, and hover states.

visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp. Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm. No bubbly or highly rounded corners.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin 1px borders (border-white/10) on cards. Use border-[#FF5722] for active/hover states to simulate HUD targeting.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace typical drop shadows with tactical glow effects: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,87,34,0.3)] for active elements.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean, flat HUD aesthetic. Use opacity to create depth (e.g., bg-white/5) instead of soft shadows.

components.top_bar: Slim top bar with 'Simple View' toggle and filter tabs. Minimalist, uppercase text. Border bottom white/10.
components.featured_strip: Horizontal strip beneath top bar. Must have orange glow border (border-[#FF5722]/50) and shadow. Contains 1-3 premium featured meets.
components.meet_card: Compact list items. Contains event name, date/time, location, category tag, thumbnail. Sharp edges. Hover state: border becomes orange, slight scale.
components.map_pin: Orange #FF5722. Sharp geometric shape (diamond or square) instead of standard teardrop. Hover: scale up + orange glow.
components.live_status_banner: Small uppercase badge [ACTIVE], [POSTPONED], [CONCLUDED] using status colors. Monospace or condensed font.
components.routing_button: 'Open in Google Maps' button. Solid orange, sharp corners, bold uppercase text. Automotive utility feel.
components.weather_overlay: Minimalist HUD style overlay in corner of meet detail or map showing winter warnings (e.g., Rain/Ice).

grids_and_layouts.desktop: Three-zone layout is a hero moment. Top bar (w-full, h-16). Below top bar: Featured Strip (h-16 or h-20). Below that: Flex container. Left Column 30-35% (Scrollable list of meets, compact). Right Column 65-70% (Interactive Map).
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Map-first full-screen. List acts as a swipe-up bottom sheet covering lower 40-60%. Filter collapses to icon. 'Simple View' moves to hamburger.
grids_and_layouts.simple_view: When toggled: Hides map completely. Expands list to full-width container with high-contrast, plain view. Removes all animations. Increases base text size slightly.

motion.intro_animation: One-time session load hero moment. Under 2.5s. Tire spooling (blur), orange motion streaks, white/grey smoke expanding, then dissolving to reveal UI. Implement via Framer Motion.
motion.hover_states: Tactile. Slight scale and glow on map pins and buttons. Do not use 'transition: all'.
motion.accessibility: CRITICAL: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Simple View must explicitly disable all motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio minimum. Text is Supernova White on Obsidian Charcoal.
accessibility.older_users: 'Simple View' mode is mandatory for older users. Needs larger tap targets and high legibility font (IBM Plex Sans).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media_and_libraries.map: Use react-leaflet with a dark mode tile layer (like CartoDB Dark Matter) or apply a CSS inversion filter to standard tiles.
media_and_libraries.routing: Use standard HTML 'a' tags with target='_blank' mapped to standard map intent URLs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, react-leaflet, leaflet, lucide-react.
Setup routing for main discovery page and meet detail pages.
Implement the Layout using Flexbox or CSS Grid matching the Three-Zone desktop specs.
The Intro Animation should be built in a top-level wrapper component that overlays the app and hides itself after 2.5s.
Ensure 'Simple View' toggle updates a global state/context to radically simplify the UI, hide the map, and expand the list.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards if they force rounded borders—override to rounded-none or rounded-sm.
For the Map, apply this CSS filter to the leaflet tile pane to make it dark (if using standard OpenStreetMap tiles): filter: invert(100%) hue-rotate(180deg) brightness(95%) contrast(90%);
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Use generous spacing for list items but maintain a compact 'dashboard' density where needed.
Do not center align the app container. No generic centered layouts.
No generic AI slop gradients. Stick strictly to the defined color palette (Charcoal #12161A, Orange #FF5722, White #FFFFFF).
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds on elements covering content. Use solid #12161A or #1A1F24.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image_urls.
Add transitions to specific interactive elements (hover, focus), NOT 'transition: all'.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Prioritize using pre-existing components when applicable, customizing their styles to match the HUD/dashboard aesthetic.
